title: Seclusion
summary: Three friends, one camping trip and a stranger who won't let them leave.
overview: When three friends' camping trip goes wrong, they cross paths with a seemingly helpful stranger whose lonely obsession traps them in a nightmare of captivity. To get out, they have to outwit his twisted devotion before it consumes them.
